{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "winterrdog",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK noting external demand and that libevent's removal enables this"
    },
    {
      "login": "b-l-u-e",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but reported socket takeover on collision and a Host header regression in bitcoin-cli"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5993254913",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A second node started with the same -rpcbind=unix:<path> will overwrite the live socket file without error, making the first node unreachable while it remains running.",
      "quote": "second node can take over a live rpc unix socket path, if two nodes use different datadirs but the same -rpcbind=unix:<path> the second node starts with no error..since it removes the first node socke",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed changes adopting ipcbind parameter format to make sockets datadir-scoped by default",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6062694537"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6062694537",
      "status_by_quote": "This should also adderss @b-l-u-e concern about multiple processes messing with each others sockets."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5999886903",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "bitcoin-cli sends the resolved IP in the HTTP Host header instead of the hostname passed via -rpcconnect=, introducing a behavior change/regression from master.",
      "quote": "the host header contains the resolved IP instead of the hostname given in `-rpcconnect=localhost`",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author pushed fix for Host header in bitcoin-cli",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6062694537"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6062694537",
      "status_by_quote": "fix `\"Host:` header in bitcoin-cli (@b-l-u-e)"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5408186323",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "users of other projects relying on Core have wanted Unix domain socket support, and previous libevent blockers are gone",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5993254913",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "b-l-u-e to review the Host header fix and datadir-scoped socket changes",
      "id": "c:6062694537"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author pushed updates addressing both of b-l-u-e's objections (Host header fix and adopting the ipcbind parameter format to avoid collisions by default), followed by rebases and test fixes."
}
